A pendulum is swinging. Five students each measure the time it takes to swing through ten
complete swings.
Three students measure the time as 17.2s. Another student measures it as 16.9s, and the fifth
student measures it as 17.0s.
What is the average period of the pendulum?
A
1.69s
B
1.70s
C
1.71s
D
1.72s
subject: Physics
